fields.name: Gregory Ochieng Otieno
fields.headline: Mechatronics Engineering Student, Certified Full Stack Software Developer
fields.about: Motivated Mechatronics Engineering student and a certified Full Stack Developer with expertise in building scalable web and mobile applications using Django, Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Kotlin, GitHub, integrated databases, integrated APIs. Currently learning electronics, control systems, automation, robotics, embedded systems, PLC programming, microcontrollers, sensors, actuators and CAD design. I also have knowledge in Firebase integration, Mpesa integration and basic Machine Learning. I'm passionate about innovations, learning and development of my skills.

fields.details: Full Stack Development course has equipped me with skills to build complete web and mobile applications. I was able to learn frontend development with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, backend development with Python and Django, and mobile app development using Kotlin and Android Studio. The course also covers practical integrations such as Firebase for authentication and data storage, M-Pesa API for payments, and GitHub for version control. I also introduced myself to machine learning with Python and basic cloud deployment concepts to take projects from development to launch.

Bachelor of Science in Mechatronics Engineering program combines mechanical engineering, electronics, computer systems, and control engineering to train graduates who can design and automate intelligent systems. I studied core areas including mechanics, thermodynamics, circuits, microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, robotics, PLC programming, and embedded systems. The course also covers software tools for modeling, simulation, and data analysis, with hands-on projects in automation, manufacturing, and machine design. I am equipped to work in industries such as manufacturing, robotics, automotive, renewable energy, and industrial automation, with skills to develop, maintain, and optimize Mechatronic systems from concept to deployment.
